name: vehicle-handover
title: Vehicle handover for review
for_each: select id,name from assets where status<>'retired'

sections.title: Open defects
sections.note: A person decides whether the vehicle can be used. This document does not certify roadworthiness.
sections.sql: select defect,severity,owner,reported_at,due_date from defect_queue where asset_id=$1 and status='open'

sections.title: Service work
sections.sql: select service,due_date,due_odometer,due_now from service_queue where asset_id=$1

sections.title: Recorded inspection
sections.sql: select a.name asset,d.name driver,i.inspected_at,i.odometer,i.result,i.signed_by,i.verified_complete from inspections i join assets a on a.id=i.asset_id left join drivers d on d.id=i.driver_id where i.id=$1

sections.title: Checklist answers at capture
sections.note: An empty list means item evidence was not imported or recorded.
sections.sql: select x->>'item' item,x->>'result' result,x->>'note' note from inspections i cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(i.answers) x where i.id=$1

sections.title: Repair evidence
sections.sql: select a.name asset,d.name defect,d.component,r.technician,r.repaired_at,r.evidence,r.currency,r.cost_cents from repairs r join defects d on d.id=r.defect_id join assets a on a.id=d.asset_id where r.id=$1
